description: This file defines a controller class for managing user turn lifecycle in a speech or dialogue system, including event handling, strategy management, and timeout handling.

classes.name: UserTurnController
classes.description: A controller class for managing user turn lifecycle, including event handling, strategy setup, and timeout management.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the UserTurnController with strategies and timeout.

methods.name: task_manager
methods.description: Property that returns the configured task manager.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the controller with a task manager and initializes strategies.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the controller and its strategies.

methods.name: update_strategies
methods.description: Replaces current strategies with new ones.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to detect user turn start/stop events.

methods.name: _setup_strategies
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for strategies.

methods.name: _cleanup_strategies
methods.description: Cleans up strategy event handlers.

methods.name: _handle_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when user starts speaking.

methods.name: _handle_user_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when user stops speaking.

methods.name: _handle_vad_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD-based user start speaking event.

methods.name: _handle_vad_user_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD-based user stop speaking event.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription frames to reset timeout.

methods.name: _on_push_frame
methods.description: Handles push frame events from strategies.

methods.name: _on_broadcast_frame
methods.description: Handles broadcast frame events from strategies.

methods.name: _on_user_turn_started
methods.description: Handles user turn start event.

methods.name: _on_user_turn_stopped
methods.description: Handles user turn stop event.

methods.name: _trigger_user_turn_start
methods.description: Triggers user turn start logic, prevents duplicate starts.

methods.name: _trigger_user_turn_stop
methods.description: Triggers user turn stop logic, prevents duplicate stops.

methods.name: _user_turn_stop_timeout_task_handler
methods.description: Asynchronous loop managing timeout for user turn stop.
